summary: Frontend half of owner decision (3), 2026-11-03. AdminPage loses the UserSplit block and the footer sentence and gains the STATISZTIKA panel (StatsPanel: six figures at the new 'stat' numeral step, the 30-day curve of people who logged with the lime end dot, the Reszletek / Szabalyok doors in one closed stack) fed by the additive panel of GET /admin/stats; the waiting count in the queue head is the panel's moderationPending, no grey zero. The queue's empty state is the graphite shield + display title (admin-moderation-v2-empty); a failed queue read is one danger line with 'Ujra' (never the false empty state). New page /admin/stats (StatisticsPage): back '< Moderacio', window switch 7 / 30 / 90 in ?days=, six blocks (users with role split bar, activity with the honesty note, coins, marketplace with the post-state split bar, coaches, system), DayBars for the series lines, loading skeleton, full-page error with the one pill 'Ujra', forbidden. Kit parts only (Numeral, Fraction, SplitBar, Sparkline, RowStack, ListRow, Segmented); two additive numeral steps (hero 80, stat 56) and one additive Sparkline tone (ink). Route is lazy + suspended, ROUTE_META row, moderation tab owns[] gains /admin/stats, check-nav-active row added. No backend file touched.

admin-moderation-v2.reason: pair picture app | Figma looked at: every block within 2 pt vertically (panel gaps measured and fixed: caption step, the 'N / 7 nap' fraction no longer grows its cell, the trend sits 16 under the grid). Figures differ because the scratch DB (seed:demo) is not the persona data (0 new in 7 days vs 2, 1 active coach vs 2, 0 / 20 vs 4 / 23).

admin-moderation-v2-empty.reason: queue answers [] and pending 0 by edits over the live answers; shield 96 pt and title within 3 pt of the frame.

admin-statistics-1.reason: six blocks, 2588 pt tall like the frame; every block within 2-3 pt; the live data differ (19 users 15/3/1 match).

admin-statistics-2.reason: error: GET /admin/statistics stubbed 500, the pair is identical in layout; loading: captured against a dev server whose middleware never answers that path (pulse-shot cannot settle such a page, so the picture is its FAILED.png), skeleton within 2 pt of the frame's left phone; the loading state therefore has no entry in states.json.

extraStates.moderation-error: GET /admin/moderation 500: the one danger line with Ujra under the queue head
extraStates.statistics-forbidden: user@ opens /admin/stats: the refusal, no statistics request (PATCH /me/prefs stubbed)
